title: SG-5.6 Re-run and fix scene unit tests with Phaser mocked
summary: Layer, content-to-entity, visibility, hover/click and fallback unit tests run against real source files
description: Context: game/tests holds layers, buildScene, sceneObject, interaction, planPreload, resolveTextureKey and preload suites, and game/frontend/tests holds the bootScene* suites. Investigation shows the bootScene suites pass and the engine suites pass when run through the frontend vitest binary, but zod is imported by game/src yet is not declared or installed for the frontend, effectContext.ts fails tsc with TS2366, and preload.test.ts relies on a path-based phaser mock. Desired behavior: these suites run green against the real source files with Phaser mocked. Why: the scene renderer needs trustworthy regression tests.
acceptance_criteria: Given the frontend package.json, when its dependencies are read, then zod is declared so game/src schema imports resolve
Given effectContext.ts, when tsc checks it, then no TS2366 error is reported for createEffect
Given game/vitest.config.ts, when the phaser alias is read, then it points to the frontend phaser install used by the preload mock
technical_constraints: Phaser stays mocked in unit tests
definition_of_done: All three requirements have Act and Verify units completed
